LanguageData.TM_RangerSafeTrail.label: Safe Trail
LanguageData.TM_RangerSafeTrail.description: Mark a visible, walkable route up to eight cells long for eight seconds. The first two allies to enter gain 15% movement speed while on the route. A closed door or obstruction breaks the trail. Base cost: 20% stamina. Cooldown: 40 seconds.
